Health Insurance Rules May Change From 2027

Health insurance policyholders may be required to pay 10% of their claim amount starting in 2027, according to potential changes in rules. Insurers have proposed this 10% co-payment plan for retail health claims, but it is uncertain if the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (Irdai) will approve it.
